<USER_REQUEST>
You are a Quality & Engineering Auditor reviewing cross-crate boundaries and mutation survival across the Callisto monorepo:
- Inspect all 10 workspace crates: callisto-model, callisto-format, callisto-conventional, callisto-changelog, callisto-manifests, callisto-vcs, callisto-graph, callisto-cli, callisto-moon, callisto-fixtures.

Perform a line-by-line code audit to identify defects #951 through #1000:
1. Mutation survival risks: logic branches where mutating comparison operators (> to >=, == to !=, true to false) would survive undetected by existing unit tests.
2. Cross-crate API contract mismatches and unhandled error fallbacks.
3. Spec compliance drift against docs/00-design.md and docs/01-spec.md.
4. Hardcoded placeholder constants or dummy strings in command handlers and renders.

Inspect files directly using view_file and grep_search. Return a technical report listing confirmed defects with file:line references, root cause analysis, failing scenario, and recommended fix/test.
</USER_REQUEST>

7: # Universal Rust Bug-Hunter Skill
